title: KLOPP SAYS FIFA IS WORSE THAN IN BLATTER'S DAY, HOPES INFANTINO IS REPLACED
description:
Klopp has opinions about FIFA. Strong ones.

Germany coach Jürgen Klopp hopes Gianni Infantino gets replaced, and says FIFA is worse than in Blatter's day. Blatter was banned from football in 2015. Klopp says it has got worse since.

Critics point to FIFA's handling of Folarin Balogun's red card at the World Cup, after which he still played against Belgium. Backlash also followed a proposed twenty billion dollar World Cup company with private investors. The election is in Rabat on 18 March 2027. Bring popcorn. Klopp brings the opinions.

Is Klopp right to say it, or is this just Klopp being Klopp? Yes or no, then tell us why.
